name: Huélamo (Spain)
description: Divided horizontally by an indented line of three points, white above and green below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Huélamo (a castle and a cross of Saint James above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Huélamo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Huélamo arms — castle and cross of Saint James above waves
